_meta.method: Each lens was read on Nikon's global imaging site (imaging.nikon.com product page, Specifications section) and cross-checked against the same lens on nikon.com.cn (技术规格 table). Selected lenses were additionally checked on nikonusa.com (Tech Specs). Announcement dates come from nikon.com/company/news year indexes and the 发布日期 shown on nikon.com.cn product pages. No value was filled from memory or from non-Nikon sites.
_meta.typography: Angle-of-view strings are Nikon's values with typography normalized to ° ′ and an en dash (the global site writes e.g. "84° - 34°20'").

notes: All 20 lenses were read on two official Nikon sites (global imaging.nikon.com and nikon.com.cn); every numeric field agreed between them except where a per-lens note says otherwise. 9 lenses were additionally read on nikonusa.com (20mm f/1.8 S, 35mm f/1.8 S, 50mm f/1.8 S, 85mm f/1.8 S, 400mm f/2.8 TC, 600mm f/4 TC, 800mm f/6.3, 180-600mm, DX 16-50mm).
NIKKOR Z 24-70mm f/2.8 S II exists (release news dated 2025-08-22); the original NIKKOR Z 24-70mm f/2.8 S is still listed alongside it and is NOT the lens recorded here.

Pages were read through an automated summarizer that quotes long rows in fragments. Numbers were cross-checked across sites, but the exact connective wording/punctuation of special_elements strings may differ slightly from the page (e.g. where a row was split in two).
DX 16-50mm: minimum aperture differs by region (global and China: f/22-40; USA: f/16). Global/China value used.
DX 16-50mm: nikon.com.cn 发布日期 is 2021/06/29, but the nikon.com release news is 2019-10-10. 2019 used.
180-600mm: Nikon's spec tables say 1,955 g without tripod collar, while the feature text on the global and China pages says about 1,995 g. Spec-table value used.
400mm f/2.8 TC: maximum reproduction ratio with the built-in teleconverter (0.23x) appears only on nikonusa.com; the global and China pages list a single 0.17x.
Noct: 0.19x reproduction ratio is on the global page; a nikonusa.com search snippet shows 0.194x; nikon.com.cn has no such row and omits ARNEO Coat from its construction row.
14-24mm f/2.8 S: Nikon lists a 112 mm filter-attachment size, but filters mount on the HB-97 hood, not on the barrel; filter_mm keeps Nikon's 112 with front_thread_on_barrel=false.
400mm f/2.8 TC, 600mm f/4 TC, 800mm f/6.3: filter_mm is null (no front thread); rear_filter_mm = 46 (rear slip-in holder). Nikon's own spec row calls this "Filter-attachment size: 46 mm".
Zoom lenses with a tripod collar (70-200, 100-400, 180-600): weight_g is the with-collar figure; the without-collar figure is in weight_without_tripod_collar_g.

announced_year is the year of Nikon's product release announcement ("Nikon releases ..."), not the earlier development announcement (Noct 2018, 400mm f/2.8 TC 2021, 800mm f/6.3 2021, 26mm f/2.8 Jan 2023) and not the on-sale date.
VR stop figures are Nikon's CIPA-standard claims under the conditions quoted in vr_note. Lenses without optical VR have vr=false (body IBIS is not considered).
F-mount dimensions (47 mm / 46.5 mm) come from comparison tables on Nikon USA product pages, where the row is labelled "Mount Diameter / Flange Distance".
